blocks.text: This document details the technical debt, architectural failures, and a three-stage remediation plan to transition Zaine from a collection of scripts to a professional autonomous agent system.
Goal: Stop system instability and unlock existing capabilities without altering core architecture.

items.text: Fix the Split-Brain DB: Redirect home_ops.py and backup routines from the stale zaine_memory.db to the active zaine_tasks.db. This ensures the 'digital sentinel' is actually monitoring the brain, not a ghost.
Illuminate the Tool Library: Map the 50 unregistered tools in tools.py into the tool_clusters.py system. This instantly increases the agent's operational surface area by 42%.
Implement Camera Mutex: Introduce a thread-safe locking mechanism in camera_stream.py. This prevents hardware contention between Face-ID, Vision, and Gesture modules, ending random camera crashes.

blocks.text: Goal: Solve the 'One-Session' limitation and inefficient context usage.

items.text: Session-Based Persistence: Replace the volatile in-memory list with a SQLite-backed 'chat_sessions' and 'messages' table. This enables 'New Chat' functionality and permanent history.
Intelligent Context Window: Shift from 12-turn FIFO to a Weighted Context Manager. Utilize the full 32k token window by dynamically injecting: User Profile -> Current Thread -> Semantic Memories.
Vectorized Retrieval: Replace SQL LIKE %word% with a lightweight local embedding store (FAISS/Chroma). This allows Zaine to retrieve memories based on meaning rather than exact keywords.

blocks.text: Goal: Maximize the 4GB VRAM ceiling and improve reasoning accuracy.

items.text: Neural Intent Routing: Replace rigid substring checks in core_router.py with a fast 'Router Prompt' using qwen2.5:3b to classify the task tier dynamically.
VRAM Orchestrator: Implement a strict model-swapping manager. When deepseek-r1:7b is required, explicitly flush the Reflex Core to prevent OOM (Out of Memory) crashes and system RAM paging.
True IDE Integration: Transform zaine_cascade.py from a terminal wrapper into an LSP-capable agent that can parse ASTs and read project structures natively.
